description: This file contains implementation of the Label class and related functions for handling dependency labels in a build system, including parsing, resolving, and generating user-visible label names.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a dependency label with methods for parsing, resolving, and displaying labels, including handling toolchains and relative labels.

methods.name: Label::Resolve
methods.description: Parses a string value into a Label object, resolving relative paths and toolchains.

methods.name: Label::GetToolchainLabel
methods.description: Returns a Label representing the toolchain.

methods.name: Label::GetWithNoToolchain
methods.description: Returns a Label without toolchain information.

methods.name: Label::GetUserVisibleName
methods.description: Generates a user-visible string representation of the label, optionally including toolchain info.
